scripts.test: node scripts/rust-check.mjs test && npm run build:rust && node --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply molis-billing-local --local --config wrangler.fixture.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute molis-billing-local --local --config wrangler.fixture.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state --file seeds/local-test-plans.sql
scripts.format: node scripts/rust-check.mjs format && prettier --config .prettierrc.json --write ../package.json ../config/platform-targets.json ../scripts scripts tests rust/src/runtime package.json wrangler.fixture.jsonc
scripts.format:check: node scripts/rust-check.mjs format:check && prettier --config .prettierrc.json --check ../package.json ../config/platform-targets.json ../scripts scripts tests rust/src/runtime package.json wrangler.fixture.jsonc
